subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): per-agent / per-channel scoping for autoCapture and autoRecall

question: Should memory-lancedb add per-agent and/or per-channel ambient autoCapture/autoRecall overrides now, and should that surface live in plugin entry config, agent config, channel config, or a broader partition policy coordinated with the existing memory isolation trackers?
rationale: The fix defines a new operator-facing config and security boundary for persistent memory behavior; source inspection proves the gap, but automation should not choose the long-term config/API policy alone.

options.title: Design With Isolation Track
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide the ambient override shape together with the broader partition and automatic recall/capture safety work before implementation.

options.title: Accept Plugin-Local Overrides
options.body: Approve a memory-lancedb-owned override map and require docs, regression tests, migration semantics, and redacted multi-agent/channel proof before landing.

options.title: Defer Until Scoped Tools Land
options.body: Wait for the scoped explicit-tool foundation in the linked draft PR to settle, then revisit ambient targeting and disabling semantics separately.

recommendation.title: Design With Isolation Track
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide the ambient override shape together with the broader partition and automatic recall/capture safety work before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across memory-lancedb and is the best available owner for product/API direction on this plugin surface.
